title: A degree-three local-weight cap and an improved relevant-variable bound
summary: We prove that the local-degree potential of a Boolean function of degree at most three is at most 5/4, using the published fact that such a function has at most ten relevant variables. Inserting this cap into Wellens's degree–block-sensitivity recurrence, with the existing exact certificates released by Épi, gives C_44 <= 4.3576549226. The reproduced preceding recurrence gives approximately 4.365467422574458; our exact degree-three cap lowers it by 1/128.
